body: Light-theme regression. The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the light branch is now `$lightness: 70%` and the dark branch is `$secondary 30%`. It looks like the values got swapped. On light themes the bold poster-name links in `.topic-meta-data h5` now render much paler, which is low contrast and different from before. The light branch should stay at 30%, and the dark branch should be `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)` to match the 100-X convention used everywhere else in this PR.

The values are swapped here. The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)`, but the light branch is now 30% and the dark branch is `$secondary 70%`. On light themes `.custom-message-length` hint text goes from light grey to near-black, and on dark themes it becomes bright instead of muted. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

This changes the light theme without meaning to. The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but the light branch is now 50%, so `.group-member-info .name` gets lighter on existing light themes. The PR only claims to change dark-theme output. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

Same problem as in desktop/user.scss. The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)`, but it was rewritten with 50%/50%, which lightens `.group-member-info .name` on light themes. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

The light-theme value changed. The original was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` and is now 50%, so this `h3` heading renders noticeably lighter on light themes. The dark branch is also wrong: it should be `$secondary 80%`, not 50%. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.
